# book_booking_calendar (Resource)

The booking_calendar records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Display name of the calendar.
- `owner_id` (String) Organization that owns the calendar.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free form notes about the calendar.
- `location_id` (String) Optional location to scope the calendar to.
- `objects` (Attributes List) The objects the calendar shows, each expanded into its bookables; a bookable or bookable type is named by its key in object_key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Optional:

- `inherits` (Boolean)
- `object_id` (String)
- `object_key` (String)
- `object_type` (String)
